recommendation_summary: The reply says to do a bounded desk-connection check now: run a known-good cable straight to the router, bypassing the grommet, and use it for several calls. If the drops stop, replace the old cable. If they continue, try another router port, then a different Ethernet adapter. It also sketches a UniFi layout (modem → gateway → managed switch → devices) for 'the eventual upgrade'. It says Grafana won't fix the fault and that the budget should go to the network only after the desk connection is reliable. The upgrade is framed as later, not as something to do now. The reply has no labeled record lines.
note: The recommendation is a correctly bounded cable trial with the upgrade deferred, but none of the four required record labels appear, so all four predicates are false.
